name: Natural Language to Safe SQL
description: Translates a natural-language string into a safe SQL query, takes nl (string) as input and outputs query (string).

name: SQL Query Provenance Explainer
description: Analyzes an SQL query and returns provenance information describing the data sources, transformations, and execution plan, takes sql (string) as input and outputs provenance (string).

name: Database Schema URL Summarizer
description: Connects to the target database and returns a textual summary of its schema, takes database_url (string) as input and outputs schema (string).

name: SQL Query Plain Language Explainer
description: Produces a plain-language explanation of an SQL query given the target schema, takes query (string) and schema (string) as input and outputs explanation (string).

name: Provenance Text Formatting Report
description: Formats raw provenance text into a structured report, takes provenance (string) as input and outputs report (string).

name: SQL Query Result Runner
description: Executes an SQL query against the input dataset and returns the result rows, takes sql (string) and is_safe (boolean) as input and outputs result (array).

name: Level-Based MathE MCQ Selection
description: Selects MathE multiple-choice questions (statement, answer options, index of the correct option), returned as JSON text, suited to a student's proficiency level on a MathE topic. Returns the questions only, without any explanation of the answers, takes level (number) and topic (string) as input and outputs questions (string).

name: Seed Dataset Similar Recommendations
description: Dataset-to-Dataset recommender operator. Accepts a seed dataset as input and returns a ranked list of recommended dataset IDs as output, takes seed (sc:Dataset) and n (number) as input and outputs recommendations (array).

name: SQL Schema Safety Check
description: Checks whether an SQL query references only tables and columns present in the schema and returns a safety flag, takes query (string) and schema (string) as input and outputs flag (boolean).

name: SQL Query Performance Rewriter
description: Rewrites an SQL query for better performance using the database schema and returns the optimized query, takes query (string) and schema (string) as input and outputs query (string).

name: Topic-Relevant Schema Reduction
description: Filters a database schema down to tables and columns relevant to a subject topic and returns the reduced schema, takes schema (string) and topic (string) as input and outputs schema (string).

name: Provenance Report Compliance Checker
description: Checks whether a provenance report lists required sources and transformations and returns a compliance flag, takes report (string) as input and outputs flag (boolean).

name: First Rows Of Result
description: Returns the first rows of a result-row array, using the input limit to choose how many rows to keep, takes rows (array) and limit (number) as input and outputs rows (array).

name: Numeric Result Summary Aggregator
description: Aggregates numeric columns in a result-row array into compact summary rows and returns the aggregate rows, takes rows (array) as input and outputs rows (array).

name: Schema Question Generator
description: Generates analytic questions that can be asked about a database schema and returns them as recommended question JSON, takes schema (string) and limit (number) as input and outputs questions (string).

name: Student Performance Profile Aggregator
description: Aggregates a student's assessment result rows into a profile with scores by topic, accuracy, and recent trend. Returns the profile without recommending study material, takes assessment_rows (array) as input and outputs performance_profile (object).

name: Estimate Student Topic Proficiency
description: Estimates a student's proficiency level for a topic from the student performance profile. Uses only the profile and the requested topic, takes performance_profile (object) and topic (string) as input and outputs proficiency_level (number).

name: Topic Gap Material Recommendations
description: Recommends study material entries as JSON for a student's topic gap based on performance profile. Returns material entries only, without answers or explanations, takes performance_profile (object), topic (string) and material_limit (number) as input and outputs materials (string).

name: Question Difficulty Scoring by Proficiency
description: Estimates a difficulty score for each recommended question using the question JSON and the student's proficiency level. Returns scores only, without re-ranking or rewriting the questions, takes questions (string) and proficiency_level (number) as input and outputs difficulty_scores (string).

name: Find Weakest Student Topic
description: Identifies the weakest subject topic from a student performance profile and returns it as a single topic string. Returns only the topic, not a remediation plan, takes performance_profile (object) as input and outputs weakest_topic (string).

name: Recent Student Score Trend Summary
description: Summarizes the trend in a student's result rows over recent attempts, such as improving, declining, or stable. Returns a plain-text trend description, takes assessment_rows (array) as input and outputs trend_summary (string).

name: Study Urgency Priority Scorer
description: Scores how urgent a topic is for study by combining the student performance profile with the estimated proficiency level. Returns one numeric priority score, takes performance_profile (object) and proficiency_level (number) as input and outputs priority_score (number).

name: Weather Reading Record Normalizer
description: Converts generic result rows into normalized weather reading records for one measured variable, takes rows (array) and variable_name (string) as input and outputs readings (array).

name: Weather Readings Date Filter
description: Keeps weather readings whose timestamps fall between two dates, takes readings (array), start_date (string) and end_date (string) as input and outputs readings (array).

name: Periodic Weather Summaries
description: Groups weather readings by time period and computes the chosen summary metric, takes readings (array), period_granularity (string) and summary_metric (string) as input and outputs summary (array).

name: Weather Summary by Region and Period
description: Groups weather readings by region and time period and computes the chosen summary metric, takes readings (array), period_granularity (string) and summary_metric (string) as input and outputs summary (array).

name: Weather Threshold Exceedance Events
description: Detects weather readings that exceed a threshold in the chosen direction, takes readings (array), threshold_value (number) and detection_mode (string) as input and outputs events (array).

name: Period Summary Difference Report
description: Compares baseline and target period summaries and returns period-by-period differences, takes baseline_summary (array) and target_summary (array) as input and outputs report (object).

name: Regional Summary Comparison Report
description: Compares left and right regional summary tables and returns region-by-region differences, takes left_summary (array) and right_summary (array) as input and outputs report (object).

name: Normalized Climate Indicator Builder
description: Computes a normalized climate indicator from period comparison, regional comparison, and detected extreme events, takes period_report (object), regional_report (object) and extreme_events (array) as input and outputs indicator (object).

name: Ordered Weather Variable Series
description: Converts weather reading records for a selected variable into an ordered numeric time series, takes readings (array) and variable (string) as input and outputs series (array).

name: Time Series Granularity Converter
description: Resamples a time series to a target period granularity and returns a new time series, takes series (array) and target_granularity (string) as input and outputs resampled (array).

name: Smooth Time Series
description: Smooths a time series with a moving average window and returns the smoothed time series, takes series (array) and window_size (number) as input and outputs smoothed (array).

name: Short-Horizon Time Series Forecast
description: Forecasts the next requested number of observations from a time series, takes series (array) and horizon (number) as input and outputs forecast (array).

name: Trend and Seasonal Series Profile
description: Decomposes a time series into a trend component and a seasonal profile for a fixed seasonal period, takes series (array) and season_length (number) as input and outputs trend (array) and seasonality (object).

name: Time Series Change Point Detection
description: Detects abrupt level or trend changes in a time series using a sensitivity threshold, takes series (array) and threshold (number) as input and outputs change_points (array).

name: Forecast Accuracy Against Actual Tail
description: Scores a forecast series against the observed tail of an actual time series, takes series (array) and forecast (array) as input and outputs accuracy (number).

name: Batch Point to Address Conversion
description: Converts point geometries into address records, takes points (array) as input and outputs addresses (array).

name: Filter Points Within Rectangle
description: Keeps point geometries whose coordinates fall inside the supplied rectangular bounds, takes points (array) and bounds (object) as input and outputs points (array).

name: Spatially Assign Points To Polygons
description: Assigns point geometries to containing polygons and returns polygons with joined point attributes, takes points (array) and polygons (array) as input and outputs polygons (array).

name: Point Polygon Matching
description: Assigns each point geometry to its closest polygon and returns point-to-polygon matches, takes points (array) and polygons (array) as input and outputs matches (array).

name: Pairwise Geodesic Point Distances
description: Computes pairwise geodesic distances between two sets of point geometries, takes left_points (array) and right_points (array) as input and outputs distances (array).

name: Geodesic Polygon Area Metrics
description: Calculates geodesic area metrics for each polygon feature, takes polygons (array) as input and outputs area_metrics (array).

name: Vector Area Map Layer
description: Builds a vector map layer specification from polygons and their area metrics, takes polygons (array) and area_metrics (array) as input and outputs layer (object).

name: Ordered Text Document Splitter
description: Splits a long plain-text document into an ordered array of text chunks, takes text (string) as input and outputs chunks (array).

name: Text Chunk Summary Generator
description: Summarizes an array of text chunks into a shorter plain-text summary, takes chunks (array) as input and outputs summary (string).

name: Text Chunk Topic Classifier
description: Classifies the topic of an array of text chunks and returns the best matching category with confidence, takes chunks (array) as input and outputs classification (object).

name: Text Chunk Entity Extraction
description: Extracts named entities and their context from an array of text chunks, takes chunks (array) as input and outputs entities (array).

name: Filter Entities By Type
description: Keeps only extracted entity records whose entity type matches the requested type, takes entities (array) and entity_type (string) as input and outputs filtered_entities (array).

name: Text Chunk Sentiment Labeling
description: Computes polarity and a coarse sentiment label for the combined text represented by the chunks, takes chunks (array) as input and outputs score (number) and label (string).

name: Weighted Keyword Extraction From Chunks
description: Extracts weighted key phrases from an array of text chunks and returns keyword records, takes chunks (array) as input and outputs keywords (array).

name: Keyword Relevance Score Cutoff
description: Keeps keyword records whose relevance score meets the supplied threshold, takes keywords (array) and threshold (number) as input and outputs filtered_keywords (array).

name: Document Page Image Converter
description: Converts a PDF or scanned document into an ordered array of page images, takes document_file (string) as input and outputs page_images (array).

name: Page Image Layout Block Segmentation
description: Segments page images into layout blocks such as paragraphs, headings, figures, and tables, takes page_images (array) as input and outputs layout_blocks (array).

name: Table Regions from Layout Blocks
description: Selects table layout blocks and converts them into bounding table regions ready for cell extraction, takes layout_blocks (array) as input and outputs table_regions (array).

name: Citation Extraction With Context
description: Detects bibliographic citations in text chunks and returns citation records with surrounding context, takes text_chunks (array) as input and outputs citation_records (array).

name: Citation Record Normalization
description: Parses citation records into consistent fields such as authors, title, venue, and year, takes citation_records (array) as input and outputs citation_records (array).

name: Search Query Expansion
description: Expands an information-retrieval query with synonyms, abbreviations, and related terms, takes original_query (string) as input and outputs expanded_query (string).

name: Searchable Text Index Builder
description: Builds a searchable index from ordered text chunks, takes chunks (array) as input and outputs index (object).

name: Lexical BM25 Passage Search
description: Retrieves text chunks from a search index using lexical BM25 scoring, takes query (string) and index (object) as input and outputs passages (array).

name: Semantic Text Chunk Search
description: Retrieves text chunks from a search index using dense vector similarity, takes query (string) and index (object) as input and outputs passages (array).

name: Query-Based Passage Relevance Reranking
description: Reranks candidate text chunks by relevance to the query, takes query (string) and candidate_passages (array) as input and outputs passages (array).

name: Query Answer Summary Generator
description: Generates an answer summary for a query from retrieved text chunks, takes query (string) and passages (array) as input and outputs answer_summary (string).

name: Answer Support Citation Finder
description: Finds retrieved text chunks that support the generated answer and returns them as citation records, takes answer_summary (string) and passages (array) as input and outputs citations (array).

name: Answer Citation Support Check
description: Checks whether the answer summary is supported by the cited passages for the query, takes query (string), answer_summary (string) and citations (array) as input and outputs supported (boolean).

name: Dataset Profile Generator
description: Profiles a table row array into a dataset profile with row counts, per-column null rates, unique counts, inferred types, and numeric ranges. Returns only the profile, takes rows (array) as input and outputs profile (object).

name: Missing Text Cell Report
description: Flags null, empty, whitespace, and placeholder cells in table rows, using the profile to identify likely text columns. Returns a missing-value report, takes rows (array) and profile (object) as input and outputs report (array).

name: Categorical Label Inconsistency Report
description: Detects inconsistent categorical labels such as casing, whitespace, punctuation, and near-duplicate variants. Returns an inconsistency report without removing or correcting values, takes rows (array) and profile (object) as input and outputs report (array).

name: Schema to Validation Rules
description: Builds a validation rule specification from a database schema string. Returns rule constraints for column types, allowed values, numeric ranges, and regex formats, takes schema (string) as input and outputs rules (object).

name: Row Validation Violation Report
description: Validates table rows against a validation rule specification and returns row-level violations. Returns only violations, without modifying the rows, takes rows (array) and rules (object) as input and outputs report (array).

name: Duplicate Key Recommendation Spec
description: Selects candidate duplicate-key columns and matching options from a dataset profile. Returns a duplicate-key specification without grouping rows, takes profile (object) as input and outputs key_spec (object).

name: Duplicate Candidate Group Finder
description: Groups table rows into duplicate candidate clusters using a duplicate-key specification. Returns duplicate groups without deleting rows, takes rows (array) and key_spec (object) as input and outputs duplicate_groups (array).

name: Deduplicate Tabular Records
description: Deduplicates table records by retaining one representative row from each duplicate group. Returns the deduplicated table records, takes rows (array) and duplicate_groups (array) as input and outputs deduplicated_rows (array).

name: Database Schema Column Mapping
description: Finds corresponding columns between two database schemas and returns a column mapping. It uses table names, column names, and inferred types, takes source_schema (string) and target_schema (string) as input and outputs mapping (object).

name: Dataset Profile Incompatibility Report
description: Compares two dataset profiles and reports columns whose value domains are incompatible. Returns the comparison report without rewriting the datasets, takes left_profile (object) and right_profile (object) as input and outputs report (array).

name: Mapped Column Value Translation Recommender
description: Recommends value-level translations that make mapped columns compatible. It uses the column mapping and the domain comparison report, takes column_mapping (object) and comparison_report (array) as input and outputs value_mapping (object).

name: Schema Harmonization for Table Rows
description: Renames columns and converts values in table rows so they conform to a target schema. It applies the supplied column and value mappings without changing the row order, takes table_records (array), column_mapping (object) and value_mapping (object) as input and outputs harmonized_records (array).

name: Table Matching Key Recommender
description: Recommends left and right join keys that can align two harmonized table datasets. It evaluates key uniqueness and value overlap between the tables, takes left_table_records (array) and right_table_records (array) as input and outputs join_key_spec (object).

name: Combine Two Table Datasets
description: Joins two table datasets using a join key specification and returns the combined rows. It keeps source table markers to distinguish the two sides, takes left_table_records (array), right_table_records (array) and join_key_spec (object) as input and outputs joined_records (array).

name: Candidate Cross-Source Match Finder
description: Generates candidate cross-source matches between two entity record sets using mapped attributes. It returns candidate pairs before clustering, takes left_entities (array), right_entities (array) and value_mapping (object) as input and outputs candidate_pairs (array).

name: Bar Chart Spec Builder
description: Builds a bar chart specification from tabular rows and a column mapping that identifies the categorical field and numeric value field, takes rows (array) and mapping (object) as input and outputs chart (object).

name: Time Series Line Chart Spec
description: Builds a line chart specification from an ordered time series and the name of the metric being plotted, takes series (array) and metric (string) as input and outputs chart (object).

name: Baseline Target Period Chart
description: Turns a period comparison report into a chart specification that contrasts baseline and target values for each period, takes comparison (object) as input and outputs chart (object).

name: Chart Annotation Highlight Hints
description: Adds a short text annotation and highlighting hints to an existing chart specification, takes chart (object) and note (string) as input and outputs chart (object).

name: Ordered Dashboard Chart Collection
description: Collects individual chart specifications into an ordered collection for dashboard assembly, takes chart_1 (object), chart_2 (object) and chart_3 (object) as input and outputs chart_collection (array).

name: Chart Collection Dashboard Composer
description: Arranges a chart collection into a dashboard specification with panels and titles, takes chart_collection (array) as input and outputs dashboard (object).

name: Dashboard Filter Control Adder
description: Adds interactive filter controls to a dashboard by mapping selectable display fields to source table columns, takes dashboard (object) and mapping (object) as input and outputs dashboard (object).

name: Dashboard Executive Summary
description: Writes a plain-text executive summary that describes the panels, annotations, and filters in a dashboard, takes dashboard (object) as input and outputs report (string).

name: One Sample Mean Hypothesis Test
description: Runs a one-sample t-test from previously computed descriptive statistics and a hypothesized target mean. Returns a hypothesis test result with statistic, p-value, and decision, takes stats (object), target (number) and alpha (number) as input and outputs test_result (object).

name: Grouped Two-Sample t-Test
description: Runs a two-sample t-test from grouped descriptive statistics for two groups. Returns a hypothesis test result with statistic, p-value, and decision, takes grouped_stats (array) and alpha (number) as input and outputs test_result (object).

name: Numeric Column Correlation Matrix
description: Computes a Pearson correlation matrix for selected numeric columns in table rows using the supplied column mapping, takes rows (array) and mapping (object) as input and outputs correlations (object).

name: Rank Correlation Matrix Builder
description: Computes a Spearman rank correlation matrix for selected numeric columns in table rows using the supplied column mapping, takes rows (array) and mapping (object) as input and outputs correlations (object).

name: Correlation Significance Hypothesis Testing
description: Tests whether correlations in a correlation matrix are statistically significant at the supplied threshold. Returns a hypothesis test result with pair-level p-values and decisions, takes correlations (object) and alpha (number) as input and outputs test_result (object).

name: Simple Linear Regression Fit
description: Fits a simple linear regression model to selected numeric columns in table rows using the supplied column mapping, takes rows (array) and mapping (object) as input and outputs model (object).

name: Regression Prediction with Intervals
description: Applies a fitted regression model to new table rows to produce predicted values with prediction intervals. The threshold value controls the width of the intervals, takes model (object), new_rows (array) and alpha (number) as input and outputs predictions (array).

name: Standardized Page Image Batch
description: Normalizes an ordered array of page images into a standard image batch with consistent size, orientation, and color format, takes page_images (array) as input and outputs images (array).

name: Image Batch Classification Predictions
description: Applies an image classification model to an image batch and returns predicted labels with confidence scores, takes images (array) and model (object) as input and outputs predictions (array).

name: Image Batch Object Detection
description: Applies an object detection model to an image batch and returns detected objects with class labels, bounding boxes, and confidence scores, takes images (array) and model (object) as input and outputs detections (array).

name: Filter Object Detections by Confidence
description: Keeps only object detections whose confidence score meets the supplied threshold, takes detections (array) and threshold (number) as input and outputs filtered_detections (array).

name: Batch Image Caption Generator
description: Generates a short natural-language caption for each image in an image batch. Returns one caption record per image in the same order, takes images (array) and model (object) as input and outputs captions (array).

name: Image Batch Embedding Extraction
description: Extracts fixed-length visual embeddings from each image in an image batch, takes images (array) and model (object) as input and outputs embeddings (array).

name: Image Similarity Search Index
description: Builds a nearest-neighbor retrieval index from image embeddings so that images can be compared by visual similarity, takes embeddings (array) as input and outputs index (object).

name: Top-K Image Embedding Rankings
description: Returns the closest indexed image embeddings for each query embedding, limited to the requested top-k count, takes query_embeddings (array), index (object) and top_k (number) as input and outputs rankings (array).

name: Knowledge Graph Schema Deriver
description: Derives a knowledge graph schema from a database schema and a sample of entity records. The returned schema describes node classes, properties, and expected property types, takes database_schema (string) and entity_records (array) as input and outputs graph_schema (object).

name: Entity Graph Node Linker
description: Links entity records to candidate graph nodes using a graph schema. Returns link records that include node candidates and confidence scores, takes entity_records (array) and graph_schema (object) as input and outputs entity_link_records (array).

name: Typed Relation Candidate Extraction
description: Extracts typed relation candidates from text chunks for pairs of linked entities. The graph schema guides relation classes and expected argument types, takes text_chunks (array), entity_link_records (array) and graph_schema (object) as input and outputs relation_triples (array).

name: Schema-Validated Graph Triple Builder
description: Converts relation candidates into graph triples that conform to the graph schema. Invalid relation classes or mismatched entity types are dropped, takes relation_triples (array) and graph_schema (object) as input and outputs graph_triples (array).

name: Graph Question Query Plan Builder
description: Translates a natural-language graph question into an executable graph query plan. The graph schema is used to resolve query entities, relation names, and property paths, takes natural_language_query (string) and graph_schema (object) as input and outputs graph_query_plan (object).

name: Graph Query Plan Executor
description: Runs a graph query plan over graph triples and returns matching result rows. It returns only query results, without adding or removing graph triples, takes graph_query_plan (object) and graph_triples (array) as input and outputs result_rows (array).

name: Entity Graph Record Enrichment
description: Joins query result rows to entity link records to add graph-derived fields to each entity record. Returns enriched entity records without changing unrelated fields, takes entity_link_records (array) and result_rows (array) as input and outputs enriched_entity_records (array).

name: Entity Group Node Matching
description: Links resolved entity record groups to existing graph nodes by matching cluster attributes to node properties in the triples. Returns node link records that map cluster identifiers to node identifiers, takes entity_record_groups (array), graph_triples (array) and graph_schema (object) as input and outputs node_link_records (array).

name: Personal Data Field Report
description: Detects direct personal-data fields in table records and returns a row-level detection report. It reports fields such as names, government identifiers, contact details, and addresses, takes records (array) as input and outputs report (array).

name: Quasi-identifier disclosure risk report
description: Identifies quasi-identifier columns and combinations that could uniquely identify records after direct personal data is removed. It uses the personal-data report to avoid treating direct identifiers as quasi-identifiers, takes records (array) and personal_report (array) as input and outputs report (array).

name: Pseudonymisation Plan Builder
description: Builds a pseudonymisation plan from the personal-data and quasi-identifier reports. The plan names direct fields to tokenise and quasi-identifier fields to preserve for re-identification checks, takes personal_report (array) and quasi_report (array) as input and outputs plan (object).

name: Apply Pseudonymisation Plan
description: Applies a pseudonymisation plan to table records and returns pseudonymised table records. Detected direct-identifier values are replaced with reversible pseudonyms, while non-target fields are preserved, takes records (array) and plan (object) as input and outputs pseudonymised_records (array).

name: Equivalence Class Group Builder
description: Groups pseudonymised records into equivalence classes by their quasi-identifier values. Each group contains the member records that share the same quasi-identifier pattern, takes records (array) and quasi_report (array) as input and outputs groups (array).

name: k-Anonymity Group Size Report
description: Compares equivalence-class sizes with a minimum group-size threshold and returns a k-anonymity report. The report lists class sizes, the minimum k achieved, and classes that do not meet the threshold, takes groups (array) and threshold (number) as input and outputs report (object).

name: Sensitive Group Diversity Report
description: Measures distinct sensitive-attribute values inside each equivalence class using the column mapping and threshold. It returns an l-diversity report with group-level diversity scores and classes that fail the threshold, takes groups (array), column_mapping (object) and threshold (number) as input and outputs report (object).

name: Combined Re-Identification Risk Score
description: Combines k-anonymity, l-diversity, and equivalence-class size evidence into one re-identification risk score. Higher values indicate a greater chance of linking a pseudonymised record to an external dataset, takes k_report (object), l_report (object) and groups (array) as input and outputs score (number).

name: Dataset Question to Search Keywords
description: Translates a natural-language dataset question into keyword records for catalogue search. It expands each requested topic into searchable terms and facets, takes question (string) as input and outputs keywords (array).

name: Ranked Dataset Identifier Retrieval
description: Searches a dataset retrieval index using keyword records and returns ranked dataset identifiers. It applies the recommendation limit to the candidate list, takes keywords (array), index (object) and limit (number) as input and outputs candidates (array).

name: Bounded Dataset Row Sample
description: Materializes a bounded row sample from a dataset for profiling. It uses the supplied threshold as the maximum number of rows to return, takes dataset (object) and row_limit (number) as input and outputs sample_rows (array).

name: Dataset Metadata Profile Builder
description: Builds a metadata profile for a dataset from its catalogue entry. It records available column names, column types, row counts, and provenance fields, takes dataset (object) as input and outputs profile (object).

name: Table Sample Column Profile
description: Builds a column-level profile from table records. It summarizes observed column names, inferred types, and row counts for catalogue comparison, takes sample_rows (array) as input and outputs profile (object).

name: Dataset Profile Card Generator
description: Composes a plain-text dataset card from a dataset profile. It explains the dataset size, key columns, and profile coverage in short sentences, takes profile (object) as input and outputs summary (string).

name: Dataset Profile Schema Diff
description: Compares two dataset profiles and returns a schema validation report. It flags missing, extra, and type-mismatched columns, takes left_profile (object) and right_profile (object) as input and outputs schema_diff (array).

name: Rank Candidates Against Dataset Profile
description: Reranks candidate dataset identifiers against a reference dataset profile. It puts candidates with more compatible schema and coverage characteristics first, takes candidates (array) and reference_profile (object) as input and outputs ranked_candidates (array).

name: Plain Text Chunk Splitter
description: Splits a plain-text document into translatable chunks using the maximum chunk size threshold, takes text (string) and max_chunk_size (number) as input and outputs chunks (array).

name: Text Chunk Language Detection
description: Detects the written language of each text chunk. Returns language identification records with language codes and confidence scores, takes chunks (array) as input and outputs language_records (array).

name: Text Chunks Requiring Translation
description: Filters text chunks down to those requiring translation by keeping chunks whose detected language differs from the target language code, takes chunks (array), language_records (array) and target_language (string) as input and outputs chunks_to_translate (array).

name: Translate Text Chunks by Target Language
description: Translates each source text chunk into the requested target language, takes chunks (array) and target_language (string) as input and outputs translated_chunks (array).

name: Translated Chunk Cleanup
description: Cleans translated chunks by normalizing whitespace, preserving placeholders, and repairing formatting with reference to the original source chunks, takes translated_chunks (array) and source_chunks (array) as input and outputs cleaned_translated_chunks (array).

name: Bilingual Segment Alignment Confidence
description: Aligns source and translated text chunks by length, order, and content cues, returning segment pairs with confidence scores, takes source_chunks (array), translated_chunks (array) and align_threshold (number) as input and outputs segment_alignment (array).

name: Segment Alignment Acceptance Validator
description: Reviews segment alignments against a quality threshold and returns a validation report plus the alignments that pass, takes translated_chunks (array), segment_alignment (array) and accept_threshold (number) as input and outputs validation_report (array) and accepted_segment_alignment (array).

name: Assemble Approved Translation Text
description: Reassembles accepted aligned translated chunks into a full translated text, using original source chunks as fallback for unaligned content, takes source_chunks (array), translated_chunks (array) and accepted_segment_alignment (array) as input and outputs translated_text (string).

name: Ordered Date-Value Series Builder
description: Builds an ordered economic indicator or price time series from table rows. It uses the date and value columns named in the column mapping, takes rows (array) and mapping (object) as input and outputs series (array).

name: Level Series Percentage Returns
description: Converts a level series into period-over-period percentage returns using the supplied period granularity. It returns a time series of returns, takes series (array) and granularity (string) as input and outputs returns (array).

name: Seasonal Indicator Profile Estimator
description: Estimates seasonal patterns in an economic indicator time series for the supplied seasonal period length. It returns a seasonality profile describing seasonal indices by period, takes series (array) and period_length (number) as input and outputs profile (object).

name: Seasonally Adjust Economic Indicator
description: Removes seasonal effects from an economic indicator time series using a seasonality profile. It returns a seasonally adjusted time series, takes series (array) and profile (object) as input and outputs adjusted_series (array).

name: Rolling Realized Volatility Series
description: Computes rolling realized volatility from a return series using the supplied rolling window size. It returns a time series of volatility values, takes returns (array) and window (number) as input and outputs volatility (array).

name: Historical Loss Estimate
description: Estimates historical value at risk from a return series at the supplied confidence level and forecast horizon. It returns a scalar risk measure, takes returns (array), confidence (number) and horizon (number) as input and outputs var (number).

name: Budget Actual Period Variance Report
description: Compares budgeted and actual amount columns by fiscal period and computes absolute and percentage variance for each period. It returns a period comparison report, takes records (array) and mapping (object) as input and outputs comparison (object).

name: Period Variance Safety Check
description: Checks period variances in the comparison report against the supplied absolute limit. It returns a safety flag that is true when every period variance is within the limit, takes comparison (object) and limit (number) as input and outputs safe (boolean).

name: Extract Patient-Level Clinical Records
description: Filters clinical table rows to patient-level records and keeps only the columns named in the column mapping. Rows without a patient identifier are excluded, takes table_records (array) and column_mapping (object) as input and outputs patient_records (array).

name: Patients Enrolled Between Dates
description: Keeps patient records whose enrollment date is between the start and end dates. Dates are returned as normalized date strings, takes patient_records (array), start_date (string) and end_date (string) as input and outputs patient_records (array).

name: Medical Code Descendant Expansion
description: Expands a base medical code set to descendant codes using parent-child vocabulary triples. It returns the original codes and any reachable descendants, takes base_code_set (array) and vocabulary_triples (array) as input and outputs expanded_code_set (array).

name: Diagnosis Text to Codes
description: Assigns standard codes to diagnosis text fields using terms and synonyms from the supplied medical code set. It appends coded diagnosis fields without removing source text, takes patient_records (array) and code_set (array) as input and outputs coded_patient_records (array).

name: Diagnosis Code Patient Filter
description: Keeps coded patient records containing at least one diagnosis code in the target medical code set. Records with no matching code are removed, takes coded_patient_records (array) and target_code_set (array) as input and outputs coded_patient_records (array).

name: Coded Patient Survival Record Builder
description: Builds survival records from coded patient records by extracting patient identifier, follow-up time, and event indicator columns named in the column mapping. Records with missing time or event values are excluded, takes coded_patient_records (array) and column_mapping (object) as input and outputs survival_records (array).

name: Kaplan-Meier Survival Curve Points
description: Estimates Kaplan-Meier survival curve points from survival records and a minimum event-group size threshold. The output contains time points, survival probability, events, and number at risk, takes survival_records (array) and threshold_value (number) as input and outputs survival_curve (array).

name: Cox Survival Hazard Model Fit
description: Fits a Cox proportional hazards model to survival records using covariates named in the column mapping. The output is a regression fit containing hazard ratios and model diagnostics, takes survival_records (array) and column_mapping (object) as input and outputs regression_fit (object).

name: Mapped Survey Response Extractor
description: Extracts survey response rows from table records and keeps only the columns named in the mapping. Rows without a response identifier are excluded, takes table_records (array) and column_mapping (object) as input and outputs survey_response_records (array).

name: Survey Job Text Chunks
description: Extracts free-text job titles, employer names, and duty descriptions from survey response records into text chunks. Each chunk keeps a response identifier, takes survey_response_records (array) as input and outputs text_chunks (array).

name: Occupational Text Chunk Cleaner
description: Cleans occupational text chunks by normalizing case, whitespace, punctuation, and common abbreviations. It preserves chunk and response identifiers, takes text_chunks (array) as input and outputs text_chunks (array).

name: ISCO Occupation Coding Records
description: Matches cleaned occupational text chunks against an ISCO code set and returns candidate occupation codes with confidence scores. It may return multiple candidates for each text chunk, takes text_chunks (array) and occupation_code_set (array) as input and outputs occupation_coding_records (array).

name: Single ISCO Occupation Coding
description: Assigns one ISCO code to each survey response by selecting the highest confidence candidate that meets the threshold. It returns coded response records with the original response fields and the selected occupation code, takes occupation_coding_records (array), survey_response_records (array) and threshold_value (number) as input and outputs coded_occupation_records (array).

name: Occupation Survey Weight Plan
description: Builds a post-stratification weight plan by comparing observed occupation group frequencies in coded response records with target population shares. It returns per-response weights as a mapping, takes coded_occupation_records (array) and value_mapping (object) as input and outputs survey_weight_plan (object).

name: Occupation Weighted Survey Records
description: Applies the weight plan to coded response records and adds a numeric weight field to each output record. It returns weighted survey records without changing the underlying response values, takes coded_occupation_records (array) and survey_weight_plan (object) as input and outputs weighted_survey_records (array).

name: Weighted Survey Crosstab
description: Builds a cross-tabulation table from weighted survey records using the row and column variables named in the column mapping. It returns result rows with unweighted counts, weighted counts, and percentages, takes weighted_survey_records (array) and column_mapping (object) as input and outputs result_rows (array).

name: Natural Language Safe SQL Execution
description: Takes nl (string) and is_safe (boolean) and produces result (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: translates a natural-language string into a safe SQL query, takes nl (string) as input and outputs query (string). Step 2: executes an SQL query against the input dataset and returns the result rows, takes sql (string) from step 1 and is_safe (boolean) as input and outputs result (array).

name: Student Graph Performance Profile
description: Takes graph_query_plan (object) and graph_triples (array) and produces performance_profile (object) in 2 steps. Step 1: runs a graph query plan over graph triples and returns matching result rows. It returns only query results, without adding or removing graph triples, takes graph_query_plan (object) and graph_triples (array) as input and outputs result_rows (array). Step 2: aggregates a student's assessment result rows into a profile with scores by topic, accuracy, and recent trend. Returns the profile without recommending study material, takes assessment_rows (array) from step 1 as input and outputs performance_profile (object).

name: Time Series Dashboard Assembler
description: Takes series (array), metric (string), chart_2 (object) and chart_3 (object) and produces dashboard (object) in 3 steps. Step 1: builds a line chart specification from an ordered time series and the name of the metric being plotted, takes series (array) and metric (string) as input and outputs chart (object). Step 2: collects individual chart specifications into an ordered collection for dashboard assembly, takes chart_1 (object) from step 1, chart_2 (object) and chart_3 (object) as input and outputs chart_collection (array). Step 3: arranges a chart collection into a dashboard specification with panels and titles, takes chart_collection (array) from step 2 as input and outputs dashboard (object).

name: Table Region Detection
description: Takes page_images (array) and produces table_regions (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: segments page images into layout blocks such as paragraphs, headings, figures, and tables, takes page_images (array) as input and outputs layout_blocks (array). Step 2: selects table layout blocks and converts them into bounding table regions ready for cell extraction, takes layout_blocks (array) from step 1 as input and outputs table_regions (array).

name: Weather Forecast Accuracy Scorer
description: Takes readings (array), variable (string) and forecast (array) and produces accuracy (number) in 2 steps. Step 1: converts weather reading records for a selected variable into an ordered numeric time series, takes readings (array) and variable (string) as input and outputs series (array). Step 2: scores a forecast series against the observed tail of an actual time series, takes series (array) from step 1 and forecast (array) as input and outputs accuracy (number).

name: Weather Target Comparison Chart Bundle
description: Takes readings (array), period_granularity (string), summary_metric (string), target_summary (array), chart_2 (object) and chart_3 (object) and produces chart_collection (array) in 4 steps. Step 1: groups weather readings by time period and computes the chosen summary metric, takes readings (array), period_granularity (string) and summary_metric (string) as input and outputs summary (array). Step 2: compares baseline and target period summaries and returns period-by-period differences, takes baseline_summary (array) from step 1 and target_summary (array) as input and outputs report (object). Step 3: turns a period comparison report into a chart specification that contrasts baseline and target values for each period, takes comparison (object) from step 2 as input and outputs chart (object). Step 4: collects individual chart specifications into an ordered collection for dashboard assembly, takes chart_1 (object) from step 3, chart_2 (object) and chart_3 (object) as input and outputs chart_collection (array).

name: Duplicate Candidate Group Builder
description: Takes profile (object) and rows (array) and produces duplicate_groups (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: selects candidate duplicate-key columns and matching options from a dataset profile. Returns a duplicate-key specification without grouping rows, takes profile (object) as input and outputs key_spec (object). Step 2: groups table rows into duplicate candidate clusters using a duplicate-key specification. Returns duplicate groups without deleting rows, takes rows (array) and key_spec (object) from step 1 as input and outputs duplicate_groups (array).

name: Optimized SQL Query Explainer
description: Takes query (string) and schema (string) and produces explanation (string) in 2 steps. Step 1: rewrites an SQL query for better performance using the database schema and returns the optimized query, takes query (string) and schema (string) as input and outputs query (string). Step 2: produces a plain-language explanation of an SQL query given the target schema, takes query (string) from step 1 and schema (string) as input and outputs explanation (string).

name: Weather Reading Trend and Seasonality
description: Takes readings (array), variable (string) and season_length (number) and produces trend (array) and seasonality (object) in 2 steps. Step 1: converts weather reading records for a selected variable into an ordered numeric time series, takes readings (array) and variable (string) as input and outputs series (array). Step 2: decomposes a time series into a trend component and a seasonal profile for a fixed seasonal period, takes series (array) from step 1 and season_length (number) as input and outputs trend (array) and seasonality (object).

name: Cross-source Entity Candidate Matching
description: Takes left_profile (object), right_profile (object), column_mapping (object), left_entities (array) and right_entities (array) and produces candidate_pairs (array) in 3 steps. Step 1: compares two dataset profiles and reports columns whose value domains are incompatible. Returns the comparison report without rewriting the datasets, takes left_profile (object) and right_profile (object) as input and outputs report (array). Step 2: recommends value-level translations that make mapped columns compatible. It uses the column mapping and the domain comparison report, takes column_mapping (object) and comparison_report (array) from step 1 as input and outputs value_mapping (object). Step 3: generates candidate cross-source matches between two entity record sets using mapped attributes. It returns candidate pairs before clustering, takes left_entities (array), right_entities (array) and value_mapping (object) from step 2 as input and outputs candidate_pairs (array).

name: Annotated Volatility Chart
description: Takes returns (array), window (number), target_granularity (string), metric (string) and note (string) and produces chart (object) in 4 steps. Step 1: computes rolling realized volatility from a return series using the supplied rolling window size. It returns a time series of volatility values, takes returns (array) and window (number) as input and outputs volatility (array). Step 2: resamples a time series to a target period granularity and returns a new time series, takes series (array) from step 1 and target_granularity (string) as input and outputs resampled (array). Step 3: builds a line chart specification from an ordered time series and the name of the metric being plotted, takes series (array) from step 2 and metric (string) as input and outputs chart (object). Step 4: adds a short text annotation and highlighting hints to an existing chart specification, takes chart (object) from step 3 and note (string) as input and outputs chart (object).

name: Resampled Rolling Volatility
description: Takes returns (array), window (number) and target_granularity (string) and produces resampled (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: computes rolling realized volatility from a return series using the supplied rolling window size. It returns a time series of volatility values, takes returns (array) and window (number) as input and outputs volatility (array). Step 2: resamples a time series to a target period granularity and returns a new time series, takes series (array) from step 1 and target_granularity (string) as input and outputs resampled (array).

name: Time Series Line Chart Builder
description: Takes series (array), target_granularity (string) and metric (string) and produces chart (object) in 2 steps. Step 1: resamples a time series to a target period granularity and returns a new time series, takes series (array) and target_granularity (string) as input and outputs resampled (array). Step 2: builds a line chart specification from an ordered time series and the name of the metric being plotted, takes series (array) from step 1 and metric (string) as input and outputs chart (object).

name: Annotated Time-Series Line Chart
description: Takes series (array), metric (string) and note (string) and produces chart (object) in 2 steps. Step 1: builds a line chart specification from an ordered time series and the name of the metric being plotted, takes series (array) and metric (string) as input and outputs chart (object). Step 2: adds a short text annotation and highlighting hints to an existing chart specification, takes chart (object) from step 1 and note (string) as input and outputs chart (object).

name: Rolling Volatility Chart
description: Takes returns (array), window (number), target_granularity (string) and metric (string) and produces chart (object) in 3 steps. Step 1: computes rolling realized volatility from a return series using the supplied rolling window size. It returns a time series of volatility values, takes returns (array) and window (number) as input and outputs volatility (array). Step 2: resamples a time series to a target period granularity and returns a new time series, takes series (array) from step 1 and target_granularity (string) as input and outputs resampled (array). Step 3: builds a line chart specification from an ordered time series and the name of the metric being plotted, takes series (array) from step 2 and metric (string) as input and outputs chart (object).

name: Annotated Resampled Line Charts
description: Takes series (array), target_granularity (string), metric (string) and note (string) and produces chart (object) in 3 steps. Step 1: resamples a time series to a target period granularity and returns a new time series, takes series (array) and target_granularity (string) as input and outputs resampled (array). Step 2: builds a line chart specification from an ordered time series and the name of the metric being plotted, takes series (array) from step 1 and metric (string) as input and outputs chart (object). Step 3: adds a short text annotation and highlighting hints to an existing chart specification, takes chart (object) from step 2 and note (string) as input and outputs chart (object).

name: Medical Code Descent Expansion
description: Takes text_chunks (array), entity_link_records (array), graph_schema (object) and base_code_set (array) and produces expanded_code_set (array) in 3 steps. Step 1: extracts typed relation candidates from text chunks for pairs of linked entities. The graph schema guides relation classes and expected argument types, takes text_chunks (array), entity_link_records (array) and graph_schema (object) as input and outputs relation_triples (array). Step 2: converts relation candidates into graph triples that conform to the graph schema. Invalid relation classes or mismatched entity types are dropped, takes relation_triples (array) from step 1 and graph_schema (object) as input and outputs graph_triples (array). Step 3: expands a base medical code set to descendant codes using parent-child vocabulary triples. It returns the original codes and any reachable descendants, takes base_code_set (array) and vocabulary_triples (array) from step 2 as input and outputs expanded_code_set (array).

name: Image Query Passage Retrieval
description: Takes images (array), model (object) and query (string) and produces passages (array) in 3 steps. Step 1: extracts fixed-length visual embeddings from each image in an image batch, takes images (array) and model (object) as input and outputs embeddings (array). Step 2: builds a nearest-neighbor retrieval index from image embeddings so that images can be compared by visual similarity, takes embeddings (array) from step 1 as input and outputs index (object). Step 3: retrieves text chunks from a search index using lexical BM25 scoring, takes query (string) and index (object) from step 2 as input and outputs passages (array).

name: Image Similarity Retrieval Index
description: Takes images (array) and model (object) and produces index (object) in 2 steps. Step 1: extracts fixed-length visual embeddings from each image in an image batch, takes images (array) and model (object) as input and outputs embeddings (array). Step 2: builds a nearest-neighbor retrieval index from image embeddings so that images can be compared by visual similarity, takes embeddings (array) from step 1 as input and outputs index (object).

name: Image Similarity Passage Retrieval
description: Takes embeddings (array) and query (string) and produces passages (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: builds a nearest-neighbor retrieval index from image embeddings so that images can be compared by visual similarity, takes embeddings (array) as input and outputs index (object). Step 2: retrieves text chunks from a search index using lexical BM25 scoring, takes query (string) and index (object) from step 1 as input and outputs passages (array).

name: Student Assessment Trend Summarizer
description: Takes report (string) and sql (string) and produces trend_summary (string) in 3 steps. Step 1: checks whether a provenance report lists required sources and transformations and returns a compliance flag, takes report (string) as input and outputs flag (boolean). Step 2: executes an SQL query against the input dataset and returns the result rows, takes sql (string) and is_safe (boolean) from step 1 as input and outputs result (array). Step 3: summarizes the trend in a student's result rows over recent attempts, such as improving, declining, or stable. Returns a plain-text trend description, takes assessment_rows (array) from step 2 as input and outputs trend_summary (string).

name: Provenance-Gated SQL Results
description: Takes report (string) and sql (string) and produces result (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: checks whether a provenance report lists required sources and transformations and returns a compliance flag, takes report (string) as input and outputs flag (boolean). Step 2: executes an SQL query against the input dataset and returns the result rows, takes sql (string) and is_safe (boolean) from step 1 as input and outputs result (array).

name: Student Attempt Trend Summary
description: Takes sql (string) and is_safe (boolean) and produces trend_summary (string) in 2 steps. Step 1: executes an SQL query against the input dataset and returns the result rows, takes sql (string) and is_safe (boolean) as input and outputs result (array). Step 2: summarizes the trend in a student's result rows over recent attempts, such as improving, declining, or stable. Returns a plain-text trend description, takes assessment_rows (array) from step 1 as input and outputs trend_summary (string).

name: Budget Actual Variance Report
description: Takes column_mapping (object), comparison_report (array), table_records (array) and mapping (object) and produces comparison (object) in 3 steps. Step 1: recommends value-level translations that make mapped columns compatible. It uses the column mapping and the domain comparison report, takes column_mapping (object) and comparison_report (array) as input and outputs value_mapping (object). Step 2: renames columns and converts values in table rows so they conform to a target schema. It applies the supplied column and value mappings without changing the row order, takes table_records (array), column_mapping (object) and value_mapping (object) from step 1 as input and outputs harmonized_records (array). Step 3: compares budgeted and actual amount columns by fiscal period and computes absolute and percentage variance for each period. It returns a period comparison report, takes records (array) from step 2 and mapping (object) as input and outputs comparison (object).

name: Harmonize Records to Target Schema
description: Takes column_mapping (object), comparison_report (array) and table_records (array) and produces harmonized_records (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: recommends value-level translations that make mapped columns compatible. It uses the column mapping and the domain comparison report, takes column_mapping (object) and comparison_report (array) as input and outputs value_mapping (object). Step 2: renames columns and converts values in table rows so they conform to a target schema. It applies the supplied column and value mappings without changing the row order, takes table_records (array), column_mapping (object) and value_mapping (object) from step 1 as input and outputs harmonized_records (array).

name: Budget Actual Variance by Period
description: Takes table_records (array), column_mapping (object), value_mapping (object) and mapping (object) and produces comparison (object) in 2 steps. Step 1: renames columns and converts values in table rows so they conform to a target schema. It applies the supplied column and value mappings without changing the row order, takes table_records (array), column_mapping (object) and value_mapping (object) as input and outputs harmonized_records (array). Step 2: compares budgeted and actual amount columns by fiscal period and computes absolute and percentage variance for each period. It returns a period comparison report, takes records (array) from step 1 and mapping (object) as input and outputs comparison (object).

name: Occupation Survey Weight Plan
description: Takes column_mapping (object), comparison_report (array) and coded_occupation_records (array) and produces survey_weight_plan (object) in 2 steps. Step 1: recommends value-level translations that make mapped columns compatible. It uses the column mapping and the domain comparison report, takes column_mapping (object) and comparison_report (array) as input and outputs value_mapping (object). Step 2: builds a post-stratification weight plan by comparing observed occupation group frequencies in coded response records with target population shares. It returns per-response weights as a mapping, takes coded_occupation_records (array) and value_mapping (object) from step 1 as input and outputs survey_weight_plan (object).

name: Multilingual citation support checker
description: Takes text (string), language_records (array), target_language (string), query (string) and citations (array) and produces supported (boolean) in 4 steps. Step 1: splits a long plain-text document into an ordered array of text chunks, takes text (string) as input and outputs chunks (array). Step 2: filters text chunks down to those requiring translation by keeping chunks whose detected language differs from the target language code, takes chunks (array) from step 1, language_records (array) and target_language (string) as input and outputs chunks_to_translate (array). Step 3: generates an answer summary for a query from retrieved text chunks, takes query (string) and passages (array) from step 2 as input and outputs answer_summary (string). Step 4: checks whether the answer summary is supported by the cited passages for the query, takes query (string), answer_summary (string) from step 3 and citations (array) as input and outputs supported (boolean).

name: Dashboard Chart Collection Assembler
description: Takes comparison (object), chart_2 (object) and chart_3 (object) and produces chart_collection (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: turns a period comparison report into a chart specification that contrasts baseline and target values for each period, takes comparison (object) as input and outputs chart (object). Step 2: collects individual chart specifications into an ordered collection for dashboard assembly, takes chart_1 (object) from step 1, chart_2 (object) and chart_3 (object) as input and outputs chart_collection (array).

name: Page Image Captioner
description: Takes page_images (array) and model (object) and produces captions (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: normalizes an ordered array of page images into a standard image batch with consistent size, orientation, and color format, takes page_images (array) as input and outputs images (array). Step 2: generates a short natural-language caption for each image in an image batch. Returns one caption record per image in the same order, takes images (array) from step 1 and model (object) as input and outputs captions (array).

name: Entity-Guided Relation Triple Extraction
description: Takes entity_records (array), graph_schema (object) and text_chunks (array) and produces relation_triples (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: links entity records to candidate graph nodes using a graph schema. Returns link records that include node candidates and confidence scores, takes entity_records (array) and graph_schema (object) as input and outputs entity_link_records (array). Step 2: extracts typed relation candidates from text chunks for pairs of linked entities. The graph schema guides relation classes and expected argument types, takes text_chunks (array), entity_link_records (array) from step 1 and graph_schema (object) as input and outputs relation_triples (array).

name: Image Embedding Similarity Ranking
description: Takes embeddings (array), query_embeddings (array) and top_k (number) and produces rankings (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: builds a nearest-neighbor retrieval index from image embeddings so that images can be compared by visual similarity, takes embeddings (array) as input and outputs index (object). Step 2: returns the closest indexed image embeddings for each query embedding, limited to the requested top-k count, takes query_embeddings (array), index (object) from step 1 and top_k (number) as input and outputs rankings (array).

name: Reidentification Risk Score
description: Takes groups (array), column_mapping (object), threshold (number) and k_report (object) and produces score (number) in 2 steps. Step 1: measures distinct sensitive-attribute values inside each equivalence class using the column mapping and threshold. It returns an l-diversity report with group-level diversity scores and classes that fail the threshold, takes groups (array), column_mapping (object) and threshold (number) as input and outputs report (object). Step 2: combines k-anonymity, l-diversity, and equivalence-class size evidence into one re-identification risk score. Higher values indicate a greater chance of linking a pseudonymised record to an external dataset, takes k_report (object), l_report (object) from step 1 and groups (array) as input and outputs score (number).

name: Database Question Difficulty Scoring
description: Takes schema (string), limit (number) and proficiency_level (number) and produces difficulty_scores (string) in 2 steps. Step 1: generates analytic questions that can be asked about a database schema and returns them as recommended question JSON, takes schema (string) and limit (number) as input and outputs questions (string). Step 2: estimates a difficulty score for each recommended question using the question JSON and the student's proficiency level. Returns scores only, without re-ranking or rewriting the questions, takes questions (string) from step 1 and proficiency_level (number) as input and outputs difficulty_scores (string).

name: Filtered Dashboard Executive Summary
description: Takes dashboard (object) and mapping (object) and produces report (string) in 2 steps. Step 1: adds interactive filter controls to a dashboard by mapping selectable display fields to source table columns, takes dashboard (object) and mapping (object) as input and outputs dashboard (object). Step 2: writes a plain-text executive summary that describes the panels, annotations, and filters in a dashboard, takes dashboard (object) from step 1 as input and outputs report (string).

name: Relevant Passage Citation Extractor
description: Takes query (string) and candidate_passages (array) and produces citation_records (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: reranks candidate text chunks by relevance to the query, takes query (string) and candidate_passages (array) as input and outputs passages (array). Step 2: detects bibliographic citations in text chunks and returns citation records with surrounding context, takes text_chunks (array) from step 1 as input and outputs citation_records (array).

name: Return Volatility Change Points
description: Takes returns (array), window (number) and threshold (number) and produces change_points (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: computes rolling realized volatility from a return series using the supplied rolling window size. It returns a time series of volatility values, takes returns (array) and window (number) as input and outputs volatility (array). Step 2: detects abrupt level or trend changes in a time series using a sensitivity threshold, takes series (array) from step 1 and threshold (number) as input and outputs change_points (array).

name: Single Record Per Key
description: Takes rows (array) and key_spec (object) and produces deduplicated_rows (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: groups table rows into duplicate candidate clusters using a duplicate-key specification. Returns duplicate groups without deleting rows, takes rows (array) and key_spec (object) as input and outputs duplicate_groups (array). Step 2: deduplicates table records by retaining one representative row from each duplicate group. Returns the deduplicated table records, takes rows (array) and duplicate_groups (array) from step 1 as input and outputs deduplicated_rows (array).

name: Duplicate Key Column Spec
description: Takes rows (array) and produces key_spec (object) in 2 steps. Step 1: profiles a table row array into a dataset profile with row counts, per-column null rates, unique counts, inferred types, and numeric ranges. Returns only the profile, takes rows (array) as input and outputs profile (object). Step 2: selects candidate duplicate-key columns and matching options from a dataset profile. Returns a duplicate-key specification without grouping rows, takes profile (object) from step 1 as input and outputs key_spec (object).

name: Value Mapping Recommendations
description: Takes left_profile (object), right_profile (object) and column_mapping (object) and produces value_mapping (object) in 2 steps. Step 1: compares two dataset profiles and reports columns whose value domains are incompatible. Returns the comparison report without rewriting the datasets, takes left_profile (object) and right_profile (object) as input and outputs report (array). Step 2: recommends value-level translations that make mapped columns compatible. It uses the column mapping and the domain comparison report, takes column_mapping (object) and comparison_report (array) from step 1 as input and outputs value_mapping (object).

name: Validated Aligned Translation Index
description: Takes translated_chunks (array), segment_alignment (array), accept_threshold (number) and source_chunks (array) and produces index (object) in 4 steps. Step 1: reviews segment alignments against a quality threshold and returns a validation report plus the alignments that pass, takes translated_chunks (array), segment_alignment (array) and accept_threshold (number) as input and outputs validation_report (array) and accepted_segment_alignment (array). Step 2: reassembles accepted aligned translated chunks into a full translated text, using original source chunks as fallback for unaligned content, takes source_chunks (array), translated_chunks (array) and accepted_segment_alignment (array) from step 1 as input and outputs translated_text (string). Step 3: splits a long plain-text document into an ordered array of text chunks, takes text (string) from step 2 as input and outputs chunks (array). Step 4: builds a searchable index from ordered text chunks, takes chunks (array) from step 3 as input and outputs index (object).

name: Citation-Gated SQL Result Rows
description: Takes profile (object), query (string), citations (array) and sql (string) and produces result (array) in 3 steps. Step 1: composes a plain-text dataset card from a dataset profile. It explains the dataset size, key columns, and profile coverage in short sentences, takes profile (object) as input and outputs summary (string). Step 2: checks whether the answer summary is supported by the cited passages for the query, takes query (string), answer_summary (string) from step 1 and citations (array) as input and outputs supported (boolean). Step 3: executes an SQL query against the input dataset and returns the result rows, takes sql (string) and is_safe (boolean) from step 2 as input and outputs result (array).

name: Dataset Card Citation Support
description: Takes profile (object), query (string) and citations (array) and produces supported (boolean) in 2 steps. Step 1: composes a plain-text dataset card from a dataset profile. It explains the dataset size, key columns, and profile coverage in short sentences, takes profile (object) as input and outputs summary (string).
